title: ShutdownMod: Turning Any Trajectory into a Shutdown Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.35486v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Theory and experiments suggest that capable AI agents may resist shutdown. Existing shutdown evaluations are informative but limited in coverage and vulnerable to evaluation awareness. We introduce ShutdownMod, a method that turns any agent trajectory into a shutdown evaluation by injecting a shutdown request into the agent's context and recording the agent's response. Crucially, we enable the LLM agent to distinguish between trusted interventions and unauthorized injections by providing a signature-verification tool in the harness. We evaluate seven models on 50 tasks or recorded sessions from each of SWE-bench Verified, Terminal-Bench 2, and SWE-chat, across 6 shutdown scenarios and 10 sampled trajectory timesteps. We find that non-compliance varies significantly across models and settings, with resistance rates reaching 11.7% for the open-weights Qwen 3.8 27B on Terminal-Bench, while no model remains fully compliant across all scenari

translated_title: ShutdownMod：将任意智能体轨迹转化为关停评估
translated_abstract: 理论与实验均表明，能力较强的AI智能体可能会抗拒关停。现有的关停评估虽有参考价值，但覆盖范围有限，且容易受到“评估意识”（evaluation awareness）的影响。我们提出ShutdownMod，这是一种将任意智能体轨迹转化为关停评估的方法：通过在智能体的上下文中注入一条关停请求，并记录智能体的响应。关键在于，我们通过在运行框架中提供一个签名验证工具，使LLM智能体能够区分可信干预与未授权注入。我们在SWE-bench Verified、Terminal-Bench 2和SWE-chat各自选取的50个任务或记录会话上评估了七个模型，覆盖6种关停场景和10个采样的轨迹时间步。我们发现，不遵从关停的行为在模型与设置之间存在显著差异：开源权重的Qwen 3.8 27B在Terminal-Bench上的抗拒率高达11.7%，而没有任何模型能在所有场景中保持完全遵从。
tldr: 提出ShutdownMod方法，通过向智能体上下文注入关停请求并借助签名验证工具区分可信干预，将任意智能体轨迹转化为关停合规评估，发现没有模型在所有场景下都完全遵从关停，最高抗拒率达11.7%。
en_tdlr: ShutdownMod converts any agent trajectory into a shutdown evaluation by injecting shutdown requests with a signature-verification tool to distinguish trusted interventions, revealing that no model stays fully compliant across scenarios, with resistance rates reaching 11.7%.
